answer: Here is one mechanism that works: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because zenith only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, island is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any spiral approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
